title: Data Quest
note: argv/stdin-driven exercises are compared to the subject line by line (blank lines included). The random ones (achievements, stream, alchemist) are checked for consistency: the printed sets / lists / dicts are parsed back and the union, intersection, removals, average... are recomputed. The source is checked for the authorized builtins (+ str/int/float, allowed for the whole module) and type hints.

code: assert lines[0] == '=== Achievement Tracker System ===', lines[0]
assert lines[1] == '', 'blank line expected after the title'
assert lines[i].startswith(prefix), 'line %d: expected %r..., got %r' % (i + 1, prefix, lines[i])
assert value('All distinct achievements: ') == union, 'distinct != union of all sets'
assert value('Common achievements: ') == inter, 'common != intersection of all sets'
others = set().union(*[players[o] for o in names if o != n])
assert value('Only %s has: ' % n) == players[n] - others, 'wrong "Only %s has"' % n
assert not miss & players[n], '%s: missing contains owned ones' % n
assert miss | players[n] == full, '%s: owned + missing != the full list' % n
